hooks.name: validate-state-write
hooks.description: Pre-validate loop-state JSON writes (parseable + version + required fields); exit 2 blocks

hooks.name: block-forbidden-scope
hooks.description: Block Write/Edit hitting forbidden_scope globs declared in active pipeline state; exit 2 blocks

hooks.name: block-dangerous-bash
hooks.description: Deny irreversible/outbound bash (git push, reset --hard, rm -rf, sudo, etc.) — backfills executor bash deny-list that Qwen Code approvalMode+tools cannot express; exit 2 blocks

hooks.name: check-verification-on-stop
hooks.description: Block stop while an active pipeline has verification_status != pass; exit 2 blocks. loop_limit caps repeated blocks so the user can escape a stuck pipeline (run /cancel-pipeline to retire it cleanly)
